scope: Official source staging, one ISO picker, negative-media/cancellation tests, and authored GameCube input through module compilation and Windows runtime staging. No install or boot with original game media.
test_assertions: PASS STRIKERS RECOMPCORE reviewed source profile reaches the shared original-media flow
PASS STRIKERS RECOMPCORE the shared modal requests exactly one G4QE01 Rev 0 ISO
PASS STRIKERS RECOMPCORE an unreviewed source origin cannot use the preparation profile
PASS STRIKERS RECOMPCORE official source reaches the media prompt without registering a playable installation
PASS STRIKERS RECOMPCORE prepared kit is exactly the pinned source archive and official README
PASS STRIKERS RECOMPCORE a prepared kit cannot be launched before verification
PASS STRIKERS RECOMPCORE the selector receives the same ISO contract as the modal
PASS STRIKERS RECOMPCORE closing the ISO picker cancels the current operation
PASS STRIKERS RECOMPCORE cancelling the selector preserves the verified source checkpoint and does not provision tools
PASS STRIKERS RECOMPCORE cancelling before selection does not ask for media
PASS STRIKERS RECOMPCORE early cancellation leaves the prepared kit untouched
PASS STRIKERS RECOMPCORE retry uses the original media contract
PASS STRIKERS RECOMPCORE an incompatible ISO is rejected before local build
PASS STRIKERS RECOMPCORE retry revalidates the existing kit and preserves the input without enabling Play
PASS STRIKERS RECOMPCORE rejection and cancellation leave no working transaction or secondary install
STRIKERS_RECOMPCORE_KIT_PASS (source, selection, cancellation and rejection; no retail game boot)
